service_enrichments.agency_name: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services

patch.requirements: Complete the official application and provide identity, civil-status and category-specific supporting documents. The portal requires personal and demographic information, a passport-size photo and uploaded supporting documents.
patch.application_process: Register through the official ePassport portal, complete the form, upload the required documents, schedule an appointment and attend the selected registration centre for verification and biometrics.
patch.office_location: Authorised passport registration centre selected during the application

service_enrichments.agency_name: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services

patch.requirements: Valid travel document and visa-category supporting documents are required. Exact requirements depend on nationality and purpose of travel.
patch.application_process: Apply through the official Malawi eVisa portal, submit the form and documents, pay the visa and convenience fees using a supported Visa or MasterCard, and await email notification.

service_enrichments.agency_name: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services

patch.requirements: Completed permit application form and category-specific supporting documents from the applicant and sponsor or employer.
patch.application_process: Apply in person through a Malawi foreign mission or through a sponsor in Malawi. Applications may be submitted at Immigration Headquarters in Blantyre or Regional Offices in Lilongwe and Mzuzu.
patch.office_location: Immigration Headquarters, Blantyre; Regional Offices in Lilongwe and Mzuzu; Malawi foreign missions

patch.requirements: Completed product-certification application, business registration details, MRA number, factory and product information, and identification of applicable Malawi standards.
patch.application_process: Complete and submit the official MBS product-certification application. Submission does not itself authorise use of the certification mark; assessment and approval are required.
patch.office_location: Malawi Bureau of Standards, P.O. Box 946, Blantyre
